name: nextScreen
evidence: Update returns it when CanTransition; OnButton sets it (MenuArenaSelect: 0x21 on confirm)

name: inputEnabled
evidence: set by UpdateInputEnabled; Update only calls ProcessInput while it is nonzero

name: active
evidence: SetAttack(..., active); HandleMessage only reacts to contacts while it is set

name: ignoreGuard
evidence: set by SetAttack when damage >= 100; ApplyDamage/ApplyKnockback skip the guard check when set

name: damage
evidence: SetAttack: damage / scale, capped at 100; passed along in HitCharacter's message

name: target
evidence: SetAttack: the target object chosen from the target player

name: hitPlayer0
evidence: per-player "already hit" flags (players 0-3 at +0x5b8..+0x5bb), cleared when the volume turns off

name: controller
evidence: AIController or PadController made in Reset (0x0e9480) from the isCpu flag; GetEntityType forwards to its GetControllerType

name: playerIndex
evidence: ctor argument; GetPlayerIndex returns it; selects the pad and the per-player table entry

name: model
evidence: SetModel stores it; GetModel returns it

name: definition
evidence: SetModel copies it from the model; Character reads its CharacterDefinition keys through it

name: velocityZ
evidence: gravity is subtracted from it each frame

name: jumpCount
evidence: CanJump compares it with maxJumpCount; OnCollision clears it on landing
